page.layout: One printed page, one text block in full width with a bracketed note at right beside the two names Lauffero and Chambrino. Top: an ornamental rule. Below: the dedication lines, then the body in order from top to bottom. No running head, no page number, no catchword.

main_text.head: Magnificentissimo, Amplissimo, Authoritate ac Potestate Conspicuo Viro,
main_text.p: Dn. ABRAHAMO à WERTH, Reipublicæ Bernensis Quæstori, quoad ditionem germanicam haud ita pridem cum laude defuncto, Fautori ac Patrono suo summo obsequiô colendo, amando.

Venerando Cœtui Ecclesiastico, Vigilantissimis Dn. Ministris & Administris, Profesoribus acutissimis ac sagacissimis, Dn. suis Mecœnatibus, Fautoribus ac Promotoribus omni observantiæ genere honorandis, & ex iis
Dn. ABRAHAMO de LOSEA, verbi Dei Ministro ac Pastori vigilantissimo, Affini suo plurimùm honorando.
Dn. DAVIDI ALBINO, Philosophiæ Professori acutissimo, Collegij minoris inspectori fidelissimo, Fautori, Studiorum suorum promotori æternùm colendo.
Dn. SAMUELI HENTZIO, in florentissimo Bernatum Lycæo Linguæ Græcæ & Philosophiæ Practicæ Professori ordinario, fratri germano dilectissimo & plurimùm fraterno amore prosequendo.
main_text.head: Ut Et
main_text.p: Dn. JOH. ANTHONIO KILCHBERGERO, Præfecturâ in Arwangen laudabiliter defuncto, Benefactori suo amantissimo honoris & amoris genere prosequendo.
main_text.head: Quin Etiam
main_text.p: Dn. CASPARO LAUFFERO, Ecclesiæ Zoffinganæ Pastoribus Vigilantissimis, Fautoribus suis colendis.Dn. CHRISTIANO CHAMBRINO,
main_text.head: Nec Non
main_text.p: Dn. WOLFFGANGO MESSMERO, Ludimagistro ludi literarij ibidem fidissimo, Præceptori suo olim amore jugiter devenerando.
Dn. ADAMO SALCHLINO, Hypodidascalo Scholæ Castrovillanæ indefesso, Affini suo multùm honorando.

p.i: Hancce dissertationem Philosophicam observantiæ, gratitudinis & amoris causâ, offert & consecrat

page.notes: The bracket at right beside the two names Lauffero and Chambrino is a grouping brace for the note, transcribed as a right-side note. Some letters in the dedications are blurred by the scan; the names Kilchbergero and Arwangen were read with some doubt. The initial "Dn." abbreviations are printed in small capitals.
